newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: OLYMPICS-Australia to issue gold Olympic coins.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-Australia to issue gold Olympic coins.

text.p: The Australian government said it will issue 240,000 gold coins and 1.6 million silver coins depicting Olympic and Australian themes in the run-up to the 2000 Games in Sydney.

Treasurer Peter Costello said in a statement that the Royal Australian Mint and the Perth Mint have signed a memorandum of understanding with the Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games for the issue of the coins between 1997 and 2000.
The 10 gramme gold proof coins will be issued in eight designs and the one ounce silver coins will be issued in 16 designs, it said. -- James Regan, Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
